effectsSummary: [TBT] MDA is closely related to MDMA. It differs mainly in how well one's own feelings are perceived (entactogenic effect), how strong empathic understanding (empathic effect) and hallucinogenic effects occur.
dosageRemark: [TBT] 1.3 mg per kg body weight (1.3 mg x 80 kg = 100 mg)
generalRisks: [TBT] Nausea to nausea, dry mouth, cramping of the jaw muscles, sweating, coordination disorders, sleep disorders and trembling.
longtermRisks: [TBT] MDA is both neurotoxic (damaging to the nerves) and hepatotoxic (damaging to the liver); regular use can lead to schizophrenia-like symptoms.
saferUse: [TBT] First test a third or half a pill.
[TBT] Wait two hours for the effect to take effect before adding more.
[TBT] With MDA, topping up is pointless, as it is effective for a long time even in small doses.
[TBT] Avoid alcohol, drink enough non-alcoholic beverages (0.3-0.5 L per hour).
[TBT] Take breaks from dancing at parties and get some fresh air in between.
[TBT] Take regular breaks from consumption. The body needs time to recover.
[TBT] People taking medication are advised to inform themselves about interactions.
